 At Jabalpur

sentences.text:
This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail, who is in jail since 01.06.2023 relating to FIR No.216/2023 registered at Police Station Moghat Road, District Khandwa (M.P.) for the offences 376, 376(2)(N),
506 of the IPC.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that prosecutrix is major.
Applicant and proscutrix were in relationship for quite some time.
There was dispute between applicant and prosecutrix and, therefore, false FIR has been lodged.
Applicant has not made any false promise to marry the prosecutrix.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.
It is submitted that offence is serious and applicant repeatedly raped the prosecutrix.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be granted bail.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5.
There is a delay in lodging of FIR and prosecutrix is major.
It appears that applicant and prosecutrix were in relationship.
6. Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rs. fifty thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his regular appearance before concerned Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial.

8. The applicant shall also abide by the conditions enumeration under Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C.
C.C. as per rules.
